full_prompt_en: A square folk-style painting arranges seven solemn figures in a straight row beneath pale branching trees and two black birds. The ground is warm beige and olive-gray, with slender trunks rising at both side edges. Fine branches arch across the top, carrying small muted green and ocher leaves. One black bird perches near the upper left and another above the far-right figure, their simple silhouettes punctuating the light background. The people face forward with quiet expressions, small dot-like eyes, and delicately colored mouths. At the front left, a short dark-haired girl wears a pale patterned dress with an ocher collar and red shoes. Behind her stands a taller man in a black suit and dark tie. A dark-bobbed woman or older girl in a mustard-yellow dress stands beside them, her white collar and cuffs cleanly separated from the warm fabric. In the center, a brown-haired girl with long side strands wears a white dress patterned with tiny muted dots. Behind and just right of her, another black-suited man rises a little higher. A girl in a pale cream patterned dress with red ribbon details stands in front of him, its layered hem marked by narrow dark and ocher bands. At the far right, a third tall black-clothed figure wears a patterned ocher neckpiece. Their bodies are narrow and elongated, with pale legs and small feet aligned along one low brown ground strip. Matte paint, faint grain, and tiny decorative marks add texture without strong modeling. Light is even and frontal, so the pale faces and dresses stand out through color contrast rather than cast shadows. The overall composition is still and orderly, using repeated upright forms, subdued warm colors, and small dark bird accents to create a tender yet slightly uncanny group portrait.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形民间风格绘画让七位神情安静的人物在浅色树枝和两只黑鸟下排成一行。底面是暖米色与橄榄灰，细树干从两侧边缘升起。纤细枝条弯过顶部，带着小小的低饱和绿叶和赭黄叶。一只黑鸟停在左上附近，另一只在最右人物头顶上方，简洁剪影点在浅背景上。人物正面朝外，神态平静，眼睛像小点，嘴唇轻轻着色。左前方，短深发女孩穿浅色纹样裙、赭黄领子和红鞋。她身后站着一名穿黑西装、打深色领带的较高男子。旁边一位黑色齐耳发女子或较年长女孩穿芥黄裙，白领和袖口从暖色布料前清楚分开。中央棕发女孩有垂在两侧的长发，穿布满低调小点的白裙。她后方偏右，另一名黑西装男子站得略高。一位穿浅奶油色纹样裙的女孩站在他前面，裙上有红色缎带细节，分层裙摆以深色和赭黄细带标出。最右侧，第三位高个黑衣人物戴着有纹样的赭黄色颈饰。人物身体纤窄修长，浅色双腿与小小的脚沿一道低矮褐色地面排列。哑光颜料、轻微颗粒和细小装饰痕迹增添肌理，却没有强烈塑形。光均匀地从正面照来，浅色面孔和衣裙主要通过色彩反差而非投影显现。整体构图静止有序，以重复竖形、低调暖色和小小黑鸟重音形成温柔却略微奇异的群像。
style_prompt_en: The folk-style painting favors flat matte areas, narrow elongated forms, and softly irregular contours. Beige, warm cream, mustard, faded olive, charcoal, and tiny red accents create a restrained, antique-feeling palette. Features and internal details are reduced to dots, short strokes, small patterned marks, and thin trim, allowing the silhouettes to remain primary. Upright forms repeat at a steady interval under a loose arching line, giving the composition formal rhythm without mechanical symmetry. Faint grain and worn-looking speckles enliven the muted ground, while the darkest accents are isolated and deliberate. Even frontal light produces little cast shadow; pale areas gain presence through value contrast against warm gray-green surroundings. Depth is shallow and organized by slight overlap and height differences. The overall effect is tender, formal, and quietly strange, with simple shapes and measured spacing carrying most of the mood.
style_prompt_zh: 这种民间风格绘画偏爱平坦哑光区域、纤窄修长形体和轻微不规则轮廓。米色、暖奶油白、芥黄、褪色橄榄绿、炭灰与极少红色重音构成克制而古旧的色谱。内部特征与细节归纳为圆点、短笔、小纹样痕迹和细边饰，使剪影保持首要地位。竖向形体以稳定间隔重复，上方有一道松散拱起的线，赋予构图正式节奏，却不流于机械对称。细微颗粒和近似磨损的斑点活跃低饱和底面，最暗重音则孤立而审慎。均匀正面光几乎不造投影；浅色区域通过明度对照暖灰绿环境获得存在感。纵深较浅，由轻微叠压与高度差组织。整体效果温柔、郑重而安静地奇异，简洁形状和有分寸的间隔承担主要气氛。
theme_en: A solemn family group under pale branches with black birds
theme_zh: 黑鸟停在浅色枝条上，一组神情安静的家庭人物并排站立
name: Amanda Blake
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
